Attack when the blade glows golden to expel lightning.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 32 |durability = 50 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Great Thunderblade}} Great Thunderblades are [[Electricity|Electric]], two-handed swords that [[Link]] can wield. They were forged by the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]] using [[Lightning]] from [[Hyrule Ridge]]. As a result of their elemental properties, they belong to the [[Magic Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} Primarily, they are found in [[Hyrule Field]] and on the [[Tabantha Frontier]]. A Great Thunderblade can be found sticking out of the earth between the jutted rocks of [[Cuho Mountain]]'s summit, and another can be found being wielded by a [[Black Moblin]] in the [[Coliseum Ruins]]. Great Thunderblades also have a possibility of spawning on [[Stalnox]]es, which have to be defeated before Link can obtain them. Being an Electric [[Weapon]], Great Thunderblades can be used to shock [[Enemy|Enemies]] and force them to drop any Weapons that they are using, making them easier to dispatch. Each swing of a Great Thunderblade temporarily drains the Electric power from it. When a Great Thunderblade is completely drained, the blade must regenerate its energy before it can cause Electric damage again. Using this sword while in this state also does not generate Electricity and pauses the regeneration for a second. Dropping a Great Thunderblade through the [[Inventory]] screen and picking it back up instantly recharges it. In addition to shocking Enemies, Great Thunderblades can be used to temporarily fire Electric pulses into certain machines. Since they are made of metal, they also attract Lightning if equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct Electricity. They sink if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]].
